title: Music Genre Taxonomy
description: A tree of music genres with sources, licences, external ids and name aliases.

$schema.description: The URL of the schema that the file follows.

name.description: The name of the data set.

schema_version.description: Version of this file layout, as semantic version.

version.description: Version of the data, as semantic version.

tree_version.description: Short digest that identifies the build of the source tree.

licence.description: SPDX licence id of the data set as a whole.

counts.description: Row counts. They must equal the real lengths of the arrays.

tag_level.description: Number of nodes with tag_level true.

sources.description: The sources that gave at least one published row.

code.description: Short code of the source. Rows refer to it.

licence.description: SPDX licence id of the data taken from the source.

retrieved.description: Date the source was read, with a note when needed.

nodes.description: The genres. One entry per genre.

key.description: Stable id of the genre: lowercase letters and digits (any script), joined by single hyphens.

tag_level.description: True when the genre is at the depth that a file genre tag usually uses, for example House or Techno.

source.description: Code of the source that first gave the genre.

licence.description: SPDX licence id of the node row.

seen_in.description: Codes of every source that lists this genre.

external.description: Ids of the same genre in other data sets. Missing ids are left out.

wikidata_id.description: Wikidata item id, such as Q123.

discogs_name.description: Name of the genre or style in the Discogs data.

discogs_kind.description: Whether Discogs lists it as a genre or as a style.

links.description: Child to parent links between nodes.

relation.description: Kind of link. Only subgenre_of exists.

source.description: Code of the source that gave the link.

licence.description: SPDX licence id of the link row.

basis.description: sourced: stated by the source. derived: computed from source data.

confidence.description: high: a source states the link. medium: a chain of two stated Wikidata subclass links. low: computed from a statistic, such as Discogs co-occurrence.

evidence.description: Short text that shows why the link exists, such as a Wikidata statement or a Discogs co-occurrence figure.

aliases.description: Other spellings of a genre name.

name.description: The spelling as written in the source.

normal.description: Normal form of the name: Unicode NFKC, case folded, & read as and, then only letters and digits kept.

node.description: Key of the node the name points to.

source.description: Code of the source that gave the alias.

licence.description: SPDX licence id of the alias row.
SPDX licence id, for example CC0-1.0 or CC-BY-4.0.

sourceCode.description: Code of an entry in sources.
